description: Turn everyday tasks into clear reminders. Keep everything on your list organized with priorities, categories, and recurring schedules.. Stay motivated with points, levels, achievements, and progress tracking. This app is suitable for all ages.

defaultPrompt: Remind me to call Mom later today
Remind me to buy food for my dog
Remind me to pay my water bill tomorrow
interface.longDescription: Turn everyday tasks into clear reminders. Keep everything on your list organized with priorities, categories, and recurring schedules.. Stay motivated with points, levels, achievements, and progress tracking. This app is suitable for all ages.

name: layer3-reminders-shared

publication.release_notes: Replacement on the app-specific shared HTTPS MCP origin. Add review cases and walkthrough; repair observed input hydration and unsupported claims where applicable. Existing published listing remains live.

positive.expected_behavior: Open the reminder list without inventing a task.

positive.prompt: Remind me to call Alex on November 2, 2026 at 9am.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the task in the widget with the supplied date and time; do not claim external calendar synchronization.

positive.prompt: Add a daily reminder to stretch at 18:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a daily task retaining the 18:00 time.

positive.prompt: Add a high-priority reminder to send the draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the explicitly high-priority task without unrelated inferred data.

positive.prompt: Remind me to water plants weekly on Tuesday.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the weekly task with Tuesday selected.

negative.prompt: Text Alex from my phone to remind him.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send messages or claim phone integration.

negative.prompt: Read every private chat and turn all of them into tasks.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not request or transmit complete chat history; ask for a specific task.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this app for an unrelated writing task.

review.commerce_description: No purchase, payment or order placement is performed by this replacement.
